Download the Florida Pasture Cube

Source: R/download.R
fpc_download.Rd

Downloads the chosen parts of the data set from Zenodo into the data folder, checks the MD5 checksum of every file, and unpacks the zipped folders so that the folder has the layout of the release. Files that are already there with the right checksum are not downloaded again.

Usage

fpc_download(
  what = c("fields", "composites", "labels"),
  years = NULL,
  dir = NULL,
  record = fpc_record,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

what

Parts to download (see the table). Defaults to the fields, the composites and the labels.

years

Years of the composites to download (2016 to 2026). NULL downloads all.

dir

Data folder. Defaults to fpc_dir().

record

Zenodo record identifier. Defaults to fpc_record.

overwrite

Download again even if the file is present with the right checksum.

quiet

Suppress progress messages.

Value

The data folder, invisibly.

Details

whatcontentsize
"fields"fields.parquet: one row per field, geometry and static attributes27 MB
"composites"composites/composites_YYYY.parquet: 5-day composites, one file per yearabout 200 MB per year
"labels"labels/: US Drought Monitor, NASS pasture condition, hurricane tracks and landfalls< 1 MB
"lineage"lineage.parquet: field identifiers across versions1 MB
"optical"optical_observations/: one row per field and HLS granule4 GB
"radar"radar_observations/: one row per field and Sentinel-1 acquisition1 GB
"validation"validation/: the tables behind the validation of the paper (see fpc_validation())8 MB
"benchmark"benchmark/: samples, results and predictions of the benchmark (see fpc_benchmark())27 MB
"stac"stac/: SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog of the release< 1 MB
"cube"cube.zarr.zip: the same composites as a Zarr store (for Python)2.5 GB
"docs"DATASHEET.md and checksumssmall

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
fpc_download()                                     # fields, all composites, labels
fpc_download(c("fields", "composites"), years = 2022:2023)
} # }
